notes: SONiC runs net-snmp, so sysObjectID answers enterprise 8072 and only sysDescr names the OS. The marker is the first words of the sysDescr its snmpd template writes: 'SONiC Software Version: SONiC.<build> - HwSku: <sku> - Distribution: Debian <n> - Kernel: <k>'. Read from the upstream template, not from a captured device, so it stays doc_claimed until a sonic-vs capture exists (docs/design/research/VENDOR_PACK_SOURCES_2026-11-09.md). No platforms yet: detection only, the same shape as the other vendors with an empty profile list.
